objective: Test whether a small causal market-state router can prospectively select specialized Defensive strategy domains and add transportable value.
selection: highest training balanced domain-classification accuracy; ties prefer fewer rules then lexical order
labels: A or B specialized setup when present; OTHER otherwise
validation: six leave-one-bear-out folds; select on five episodes and apply unchanged to sixth
note: This stage tests router discrimination/transport before portfolio integration; exact daily MTM remains required before production/preserved50 portfolio validation.
